meta.name: model-pruning
meta.description: Reduce LLM size and accelerate inference using pruning techniques like Wanda and SparseGPT. Use when compressing models without retraining, achieving 50% sparsity with minimal accuracy loss, or enabling faster inference on hardware accelerators. Covers unstructured pruning, structured pruning, N:M sparsity, magnitude pruning, and one-shot methods.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩大模型体积并加速推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不重新训练的情况下减小LLM体积并提升推理速度。
copy.tagline_en: Compress large models and accelerate inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reduce LLM size and speed up inference without retraining.

howto.what: 当你需要压缩大语言模型、减少计算量时，Claude 会使用 Wanda、SparseGPT 等剪枝技术，生成代码来移除部分权重（如 50% 稀疏度），从而缩小模型体积、加速推理，且无需重新训练。
howto.when: 当你要求压缩模型尺寸、减少内存占用或提升推理速度时，特别是希望一次性剪枝而不重新训练时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Wanda 对 Llama-2-7b 做 50% 稀疏度剪枝。
say.note: 生成 Wanda 剪枝代码并给出说明。

say.text: 如何用 SparseGPT 进行一次性剪枝？
say.note: 提供 SparseGPT 的使用示例和参数。

say.text: 写一个 N:M 剪枝的例子，目标 2:4 稀疏度。
say.note: 生成兼容 NVIDIA 稀疏张量核心的代码。

howto.what_en: When you need to compress a large language model or reduce computation, Claude uses pruning techniques like Wanda and SparseGPT to generate code that removes a fraction of weights (e.g., 50% sparsity), shrinking model size and accelerating inference without retraining.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to reduce model size, memory footprint, or speed up inference, especially via one-shot pruning without retraining.

say_en.text: Apply Wanda pruning to Llama-2-7b with 50% sparsity.
say_en.note: Generates Wanda pruning code and instructions.

say_en.text: How to use SparseGPT for one-shot pruning?
Write an N:M pruning example targeting 2:4 sparsity.
say_en.note: Creates code compatible with NVIDIA sparse tensor cores.
